keyEvents.text: Goal! Swansea City 0, West Bromwich Albion 1. Isaac Price (West Bromwich Albion) right footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Kareem Tunde.
Goal! Swansea City 1, West Bromwich Albion 1. Moussa Yeo (Swansea City) header from very close range to the top right corner. Assisted by Josh Tymon with a cross.
Delay in match because of an injury Brayann Pereira (West Bromwich Albion).
Delay in match because of an injury Stephen Welsh (Swansea City).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Swansea City 1, West Bromwich Albion 2. Rabby Nzingoula (West Bromwich Albion) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner following a corner.
Josh Tymon (Swansea City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Penalty saved. Isaac Price (West Bromwich Albion) right footed shot saved in the centre of the goal by Lawrence Vigouroux (Swansea City).
Goal! Swansea City 2, West Bromwich Albion 2. Elijah Just (Swansea City) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Eom Ji-Sung.
Second Half begins Swansea City 2, West Bromwich Albion 2.
Brayann Pereira (West Bromwich Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Moussa Yeo (Swansea City).
Substitution, Swansea City. Joseph Opoku replaces Moussa Yeo because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Ben Cabango (Swansea City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Chris Mepham (West Bromwich Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
